id.description: UUID v4. Matches the players/<uuid>/ folder name.

aliases.description: Other names this player is called by, used when resolving a name list.

position.description: Primary position. Secondary positions belong in profile.

rating.description: Relative to this group only. 1 = weakest player in the group, 10 = strongest. Not an absolute skill level. Half points allowed.

fitness.description: Relative stamina over a full game. Half points allowed.

profile.description: Prose description: style of play, strengths, weaknesses, who they work well with.
